description: This file defines an interface for the RDK Window Manager within the WPEFramework, including notification events and control functions for managing display, input, app focus, visibility, and other windowing features. It also declares an inner notification interface for event callbacks.

classes.name: IRDKWindowManager
classes.description: An interface for managing window display, notifications, input interception, focus, visibility, and other window-related operations, along with a nested notification interface for event callbacks.

classes.name: IRDKWindowManager::INotification
classes.description: An interface for receiving window related notification events such as app connection, visibility changes, focus, inactivity, and disconnection.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification callback interface to receive window events.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a previously registered notification callback interface.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the window manager service with a given shell interface.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Deinitializes the window manager service.

methods.name: CreateDisplay
methods.description: Creates a display window with specified parameters.

methods.name: GetApps
methods.description: Retrieves the list of currently active and available applications.

methods.name: AddKeyIntercept
methods.description: Registers a key intercept for a specific key code and client.

methods.name: AddKeyIntercepts
methods.description: Registers multiple key intercepts in a single operation.

methods.name: RemoveKeyIntercept
methods.description: Removes a key intercept for a specific key code and client.

methods.name: AddKeyListener
methods.description: Registers listeners for specific keys.

methods.name: RemoveKeyListener
methods.description: Removes listeners for specific keys.

methods.name: InjectKey
methods.description: Simulates a key press event with optional modifiers.

methods.name: GenerateKey
methods.description: Generates a key event for specified keys and client.

methods.name: EnableInactivityReporting
methods.description: Enables or disables inactivity reporting.

methods.name: SetInactivityInterval
methods.description: Sets the inactivity interval.

methods.name: ResetInactivityTime
methods.description: Resets the inactivity timer.

methods.name: EnableKeyRepeats
methods.description: Enables or disables key repeat functionality.

methods.name: GetKeyRepeatsEnabled
methods.description: Retrieves whether key repeats are enabled.

methods.name: IgnoreKeyInputs
methods.description: Ignore or accept key inputs globally.

methods.name: EnableInputEvents
methods.description: Enables input events for specified clients.

methods.name: KeyRepeatConfig
methods.description: Configures key repeat parameters.

methods.name: SetFocus
methods.description: Sets focus to the specified application or client.

methods.name: SetVisible
methods.description: Sets the visibility state of a client/application.

methods.name: RenderReady
methods.description: Checks if the first frame rendered for a client/application.

methods.name: EnableDisplayRender
methods.description: Enables or disables Wayland display rendering for a client.

methods.name: GetLastKeyInfo
methods.description: Retrieves info about the last key press event (key code, modifiers, timestamp).
